title: Panel Management
description: Manage various panels on devices (network ports, fiber, power, etc.)

apply.untouched: Ports are matched by number. State, label, notes and connections of existing ports are not changed. Ports the template does not have are kept when they are in use or carry a state, label or notes.

suggest.hint: Checked templates become panels with ports right after the device is created.

templates.title: Panel templates
templates.description: Define panels with the parametric generator or by placing ports. Linked to a device model, a template is offered when creating devices and can be applied to all devices of the model.
templates.deviceModelHint: Linked templates are offered when creating devices of the model and can be batch applied
templates.revisionHint: {{count}} panels use this template; changing ports raises the revision and those panels are flagged for re-apply
templates.manualHint: Saving hand-placed ports drops the generator parameters.
templates.toGeneratorContent: Hand-placed positions will be replaced by the generator output.
templates.deleteConfirmDescription: The {{count}} panels using it keep their ports; only the link to the template is removed.
